info.title: Yayatoh API
info.description:
Yayatoh `/v1`. Changes are additive only (oasdiff gate).

- **Auth:** an org API key (`Authorization: Bearer yy_live_…`, created in the console under
  Settings → API keys) or a user session token from `POST /v1/auth/login`. No cookies.
- **Test keys:** `yy_test_…` keys are read-only and carry no personal data (`org:read`,
  `events:read` only), with a smaller rate limit. Build against them, ship with a live key.
- **Tenant:** org resources live under `/v1/orgs/{org}`; the org must match the key, or the
  user must be a member. It is never read from a header.
- **Pagination:** `limit` (≤ 100) and `cursor` (the previous page’s `nextCursor`).
- **Errors:** RFC 9457 `application/problem+json` with a stable `code`.
- **Idempotency:** every write needs an `Idempotency-Key`; a retry returns the stored result.
- **Rate limits:** per key or user, with `RateLimit-*` headers and `Retry-After` on 429.
- **Request ids:** every response has `X-Request-Id` (send your own to correlate).
- **Caching:** content reads send an `ETag`; send it back as `If-None-Match` for a 304.
- **Deprecation:** a deprecated route answers with `Deprecation` (RFC 9745) and, once a
  date is set, `Sunset` (RFC 8594) and a `Link` to the migration notes.

deviceToken.description: Scanner device token (`yyd_…`), issued once at enrollment.

apiKey.description: An org API key (`yy_live_…`, or a read-only `yy_test_…` test key). Shown once when created; scoped; bound to one org.

venueSlug.description: The venue’s slug when it is in the directory (`GET /v1/public/venues/{slug}`).

PublicEventSection.description: A content block of the event page; `kind` says which `content` shape it has.

PublicAnnouncement.description: A published announcement for everyone (`public` audience).

PublicEventDate.description: One date of a multi-date event (no capacity numbers).

timezone.description: The event’s IANA timezone; days and times render in it.

PublicAgenda.description: Sessions grouped by day in the event’s timezone, in start order.

date.description: The day in the event’s timezone (`YYYY-MM-DD`).

dateId.description: The event date it belongs to (multi-date events).

SpeakerDetail.description: A speaker and the sessions they speak in.

PublicSponsorTier.description: A sponsor package with its sponsors, in display order.

url.description: Absolute, content-hashed and immutable (`…/{width}-{sha256}.{ext}`): cache it forever.

fallback.description: The JPEG/PNG (or SVG) every client can show.

upcomingEvents.description: Upcoming public events at the venue.

PublicVenue.description: A venue listed in the directory (quote requests are not exposed).

EventSection.description: A content block of the event page; `kind` says which `content` shape it has.

publishedAt.description: Null while it is a draft.

Agenda.description: The organizer’s agenda with track and room ids and capacities.

date.description: The day in the event’s timezone (`YYYY-MM-DD`).

timezone.description: IANA timezone; event times render in it.

RefundRequest.description: Refund whole tickets (`ticketIds`) or an amount (`amountMinor`), not both.

code.description: The QR payload (`yy1…`) or the printed short code.

ManifestOverlap.description: `true` re-reads the last page’s rows as well (after a crash mid-page).

get.description: Answers 200 while the API is up. No credential; not rate limited beyond the anonymous budget.

post.summary: Sign in with email and password; returns a bearer session token (no cookies)
post.description: Signs in with email and password and returns a session token to send as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. No cookie is set. Accounts with two-factor sign-in get `step_up_required`: use the web sign-in. Limited per account (5 per 15 min) and per IP.
